name: Color Switch
summary:
"Tap the ball carefully through each obstacle and your ball will switch color with some powerups. You must follow the color pattern on each obstacle to cross it! Be careful not to pass through the wrong color, or you'll have to start again."

The goal of the game is to tap a ball through various obstacles with colored patterns, making sure that your ball matches the color you go through. Various power-ups will switch your color each time you pass an obstacle. During the game, you will also collect stars that you can use to buy more balls. In Color Switch, there is an "arcade mode", known as Endless Mode, and there is a "level mode", known as Game Mode. In Endless Mode, the player has to go through an endless amount of obstacles, and in Game Mode, there are finite levels that the player has to complete.
